Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente,…

description:
Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) für agentische Softwareentwicklung
Die Kanzlei Prinz ist auf Online-Reputationsrecht spezialisiert: Für über 2.300 Mandanten, überwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen, sorgen wir dafür, dass rechtswidrige Bewertungen auf Plattformen wie kununu, Google und Trustpilot verschwinden. Dabei läuft bei uns alles über unser selbst entwickeltes Case-Management-System.
Software als Grundlage unserer Dienstleistung
So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum.
Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus.
Warum wir dich suchen
Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir wissen also ziemlich genau, was zu tun ist – Ideen, Konzepte und ein gut…

description:
Product Lead

About Us
Logistics is a $12 trillion industry powered by hard-working people, yet much of its operational work is still manual and running on tribal knowledge. We believe another software tool won’t solve this, but we need to change how work gets done in logistics.
That’s why we're building the autonomous supply chain: AI workers that support their human co-workers and coordinate the work across company boundaries. We automate workflows first, then connect trading partners, and finally orchestrate entire supply chain networks.
As former logistics operators, we understand this industry inside out: its complexity, exceptions and the realities of running a low-margin business. We are backed by leading European investors and are building a new category for the global logistics industry.
The Role
As our Product Lead, you will shape our platform strategy and own the product roadmap from first insight to shipped feature.
We are building a scalable platform, not a services business. Every customer project teaches us something, and your job is to turn those lessons into platform capabilities that make the next customer faster and cheaper to onboard. You will decide what becomes a configurable platform feature and what we deliberately don't build into the platform.
Tasks
Our product:

description:
About Caddy Comps
Caddy Comps is the UK’s leading golf prize competition platform. Founded in 2021, we have awarded over £15m in prizes to more than 50,000 winners, maintaining a 5-star Trustpilot rating from over 8,700 reviews. As we continue to scale, we need a Finance Manager to take ownership of our financial operations on a part-time basis.

The role
You will be our only finance hire, reporting to the COO. You will own the monthly accounts, reporting and payroll across the group. Our external accountants continue to handle year-end accounts, corporation tax and statutory filings.
What you will do
Prepare monthly management accounts for each group entity and run the month-end close

Reconcile bank accounts, cards, payment processors and platform payouts

Run monthly payroll, pensions and PAYE/NI, and keep basic HR records

Process supplier invoices and prepare payment runs for approval

Prepare VAT workings and information for our accountants

Produce a monthly KPI pack and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

Build the annual budget and monthly reforecasts

About you
2+ years in a finance role, including owning a monthly close

AAT Level 4 or part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, or equivalent experience

Hands-on UK payroll and VAT experience

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence with accounting software

Organised, accurate and a clear communicator

Experience in e-commerce or across more than one entity is a bonus

Employee discounts on our…

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. About Us
Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role
As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities
Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. About us

The role
You measure, reconstruct and analyze real samples to find out how well our tool performs, and what holds it back. You work between the optics lab, the algorithm team, and our customers' samples, and you become our in-house expert on system performance.

Develop full recipes for new samples: decide what and how to measure, run scans on the lab tools, configure and run reconstructions in our Python/JAX pipeline, and judge the quality of the output

title: Analytics Engineer, Revenue Operations (BI & Analytics, India Remote) - Hours 1-
summary: Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing,…
description:
Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
This is an early-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
What You'll Do:

Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.

Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.

Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.

Keep Redshift fast and cost-effective.

Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.

Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.

Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.

De IT producten waar je aan werkt dragen bij aan statistieken over de bouw, industrie, transport, de zakelijke dienstverlening en bijvoorbeeld de motor- en autohandel.

description:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027
Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden?
Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten?

Dit is jouw uitdaging
Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG).
Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen.
Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid.
Je onderzoekt onder andere:
Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties?

Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG?

Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen?

Airbnb’s Data Infrastructure organization builds the platforms that power data across the company. Within it, the Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) pillar builds the platform that moves data between Airbnb’s storage engines and transforms it along the way.

Today, data moves through many bespoke, one-off pipelines that are built and maintained differently by each team. We’re replacing them with one unified, declarative platform. You define data once, and it is replicated everywhere it needs to go. This work underpins Airbnb’s Data as a Service initiative.

You’ll join the team that owns three connected layers of that platform:

Control plane: the layer that turns declarative data definitions into running pipelines, including provisioning, runtime selection, and lifecycle management.

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

Realtime Data Infrastructure (RTDI): Kafka and the streaming transport layer that real-time data flows through at scale.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Money Management products (Financial Accounts, Treasury, Global Payouts, Issuing, and Capital) let businesses and platforms hold, move, spend, and earn on their money using the same infrastructure they already use for payments. APAC Money as a Service (MaaS) is a newly formed team, based in Singapore, responsible for bringing this product suite to Asia-Pacific markets, enabling global businesses and platforms to use these capabilities directly or offer them to their APAC users, and building the local rails, compliance, and partner integrations that make it all work.

None of this works without financial partners: the banks, card networks, and licensed institutions whose systems our products run on in each market. About the team

Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.

Our web and API surfaces handle requests from guests and hosts alongside a growing volume of automated agents: AI assistants, crawlers, and scrapers. We build the systems that bring clarity to this traffic, combining in-house ML and vendor signals to decide in real time how to serve billions of daily requests. Anti-bot and anti-scraping detection is our most adversarial mandate, but the wider challenge is full traffic classification: building evaluation frameworks that tell legitimate automation apart from abusive actors, so high-stakes decisions hold up across the fleet.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will architect and maintain Airbnb’s end-to-end traffic classification ML systems, balancing high-performance model deployment with rigorous offline data pipelines. Success is measured by your ability to harden edge-traffic policies—targeting reduced bot-incident MTTM—and by establishing rigorous evaluation practices that ensure foundational signal accuracy and evasion-resistance across the fleet.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
